reviews.body:
Two related places have the same one-way rule:
- `convert-posix` (`cmd/internal/gwcli/utils.go:399`) has its own `filepath.Rel` check that also accepts a sidecar containing the root. Please reuse the same helper so both commands agree.
- `extra/example.conf` says nothing about nesting for `VGW_META_SIDECAR`, and `VGW_VERSIONING_DIR` only says "must NOT be a subdirectory". Please document "must not be the same as, inside, or contain the root directory".

review_comments.body: While fixing this: the comparison uses `filepath.Abs` only, so a symlinked path segment hides nesting in both directions. Root `/d/link/gwroot` (`link -> real`) with sidecar `/d/real/gwroot/inner` is accepted, and so is the reverse. Both dirs must exist anyway, so please compare `filepath.EvalSymlinks` of both. That also handles macOS `/tmp` vs `/private/tmp`.

Nit: with this message gone, a bad `--sidecar` now fails with "the root directory X contains the directory Y", which doesn't say which flag is wrong (`validateSubDir` is shared with `--versioning-dir`). Please wrap it at the call sites, e.g. `fmt.Errorf("invalid sidecar directory: %w", err)` and the same for the versioning dir.

This passes on any error, e.g. a stat failure if `inside` weren't created. Please assert the nesting error itself (a sentinel checked with `errors.Is`, or at least the message).

Please also make it table-driven and add cases for:
- sidecar == root (rejected)
- sidecar is the parent / an ancestor of root (rejected, after the fix above)
- symlinked path hiding the nesting (rejected)
- root `.` with sidecar `../s3-sidecar` in default (non-AbsolutePaths) mode (accepted; main rejected this too), using `t.Chdir`
- trailing separator on the root
This uses `meta.XattrMeta{}` with `SideCarDir` set, a combination the CLI never builds. Please use `meta.NewSideCar(sibling)` so the test runs the real sidecar setup.

comments.body: This won't automatically run in continuous integration without approval. A member of the Versity organization must allow it.

Thanks for the thorough review, all points are addressed in the new commit:
- `validateSubDir` now rejects equal, inside, and containing directories (two-way check), so it also covers `--versioning-dir`; the repro (`--sidecar /d /d/gwroot`) is now refused at startup.
- Both paths are compared after `EvalSymlinks`, resolving through the closest existing ancestor when a path does not exist yet.
- The nesting error is the sentinel `posix.ErrDirsNested` and is wrapped at the call sites as `invalid sidecar directory: ...` / `invalid versioning directory: ...`.
- `convert-posix` now calls the same exported helper (`posix.CheckDirsNotNested`) so both commands agree.
- `extra/example.conf` documents "must not be the same as, inside, or contain" for `VGW_META_SIDECAR` and `VGW_VERSIONING_DIR`.
- `sidecardir_test.go` is table-driven with `errors.Is` assertions and covers sidecar == root, ancestor of root, symlinked nesting in both directions, trailing separator, and root `.` with `../s3-sidecar` via `t.Chdir`; it uses `meta.NewSideCar`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
